messages: Maya (product): Quick thread — ran a small design pass on the Compliance table. A few UX nits around region ordering, KMS badges, and audit-log copy. Figma here: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/console-compliance (look at Audit table frame). Jordan (design): Nice — saw the figma. First pass thoughts: 1) Move Region label to 'Region (data residency)' to reduce ambiguity. 2) For KMS, show a tiny chip: 'Customer-managed' / 'Redwood-managed' instead of verbose text. 3) Consider compact rows for high-density org views. Sam (eng): Technical note: pulling KMS ownership requires an extra downstream call per row right now. For perf we can: a) show an icon + tooltip (no extra call) or b) batch the ownership fetch for visible rows. Pref a) for now. Example aria-friendly pattern: ```html ``` Jordan (design): Love icon + tooltip. Proposal for compact chip: `🔒 Customer-managed` with 12px font and 8px padding. If the chip is too subtle, add a 1px border. Riley (accessibility): Chip contrast is borderline at 12px weight. Also screen-reader notes: do not rely on icon alone. Add a visually-hidden text node for assistive tech, e.g.: ```html 🔒 Customer-managed key ``` And ensure tooltip text is reachable by keyboard. Sam (eng): Good point. We can implement `sr-only` and keep the icon for sighted users. Will review tooltip keyboard focus. Also flagging perf: batch fallback will be necessary if orgs have thousands of entries. Jordan (design): Small copy nit in Audit log: change header from `Timestamp` to `Event time (UTC)` and in action lines prefer `performed` over `initiated` (e.g., `Key rotation performed by alice@example.com`). Feels clearer for downstream legal/audit readers. Maya (product): Agreed on copy. Also UX question: should we include region badges inline in the audit rows? Might be helpful when scanning. Maybe a pill: `EU (Frankfurt)` next to event. Riley (accessibility): If we add region pills, make sure to include `aria-label="Region: EU - Frankfurt"` and do not rely solely on color. Use shape or text. Sam (eng): Inline region pill OK. Implementation: use server-side abbreviated region code + full name in `aria-label` to avoid extra lookup. Example: `EU (Frankfurt)`. Maya (product): Great. Plan: Jordan updates Figma with chip + pill and the audit-copy changes; Sam to prototype icon+sr-only and check batch perf; Riley to run contrast/keyboard checklist on the updated comp. I'll file follow-up ticket after Figma update. :thumbsup: Jordan (design): I'll update figma and leave comments for the eng impl (linking the aria snippet). Sam (eng): I'll prototype in a small branch — if fetch cost is low we can expand to prefetch in the next sprint. Riley (accessibility): I'll add the a11y checklist items to the ticket (contrast ratio, keyboard focus order, screen-reader labels). Maya (product): Thanks team. Tiny follow-up: can we also tweak the KMS copy from `Managed by Redwood` to `Redwood-managed key`? It's more consistent with the chip phrasing. Jordan (design): Yep, makes sense. I'll update copy. deploy-bot: Heads-up: quick infra deploy scheduled 1719999000 — nothing UX-facing in this window but ping if you want a slot for the prototype review. Maya (product): OK — will coordinate. Thanks all!
